expression_units: source-normalized linear-scale abundance; not raw read counts
heatmap_standardization: selected-sample mean and sample standard deviation, ddof=1
feature_ranking: descending log-expression variance, then gene identifier ascending
pca: center log-expression features; no feature scaling; full-cohort SVD; fixed coordinates under browser filtering
pca_sign: largest absolute loading per component is positive; first feature breaks ties
missing_purity: retain as null and flag as unavailable
vaf_policy: alt / (ref + alt); unknown VAF excluded at every threshold including zero
variant_measure: retained records, not mutations per megabase
cna: source discrete calls -2,-1,0,1,2; high-level amplification=2, deep deletion=-2
public_feature_policy: exclude missing symbols/Entrez IDs and every ambiguous duplicated symbol or Entrez row before analysis
public_sample_policy: exact intersection of clinical sample IDs, RNA matrix/case list, mutation coverage and CNA matrix/case list; one sample per patient
selection_policy: All eligible samples and unambiguous measured features are included; no feature or sample is selected by a desired result.
